headline: D2 ₹925 Cr All-India After D18. BOI Verified. 3rd Weekend ₹68 Cr. ₹1,000 Cr This Week.
subline: BOI Hindi ₹887.33 Cr (confirmed) · Boxoffy all-India ~₹925 Cr (BOI + Pinkvilla cross-verified) · Sacnilk ₹1,013 Cr — 9.5% inflated, rejected · 3rd weekend ₹68 Cr (₹20+₹23+₹25 BOI) · ₹1,000 Cr all-India ETA: D22–D25.

sources.name: Box Office India
sources.quote: D2 Hindi nett ₹887.33 Cr through D18. 3rd weekend ₹68 Cr (₹20+₹23+₹25). Film on target for ₹1,000 Cr nett — biggest BLOCKBUSTER of recent times, footfalls to cross 4 Cr.
sources.analysis: BOI breakdown (Hindi): Week 1 ₹590.36 Cr · Week 2 ₹228.97 Cr · 3rd Fri ₹20 Cr · 3rd Sat ₹23 Cr · 3rd Sun ₹25 Cr · Total ₹887.33 Cr. BOI explicitly tracks Hindi. Drop vs Week 2 is 55-60% including holiday adjustment on Friday. Week 3 expected to deliver ~₹100 Cr. Week 4 also expected good with no competition. BOI verdict: film remains on track for ₹1,000 Cr nett — a milestone dependent on the next few weeks staying healthy.

sources.name: Pinkvilla
sources.quote: All-India nett ~₹925 Cr after D18. Hindi ₹870 Cr. South-dubbed versions contributing ~₹55 Cr total. ₹1,000 Cr all-India easily achievable — Hindi alone now difficult.
sources.analysis: Pinkvilla tracked Hindi at ₹870 Cr through D18 (Wk1 ₹571 Cr + Wk2 ₹230.50 Cr + Wknd3 ₹68.50 Cr). South-dubbed versions: ₹49 Cr through D16 + D17-D18 additions ≈ ₹55 Cr total. All-India nett ~₹925 Cr after D18, confirms ₹900 Cr mark crossed on 3rd Sunday. Pinkvilla notes the 3rd Saturday of ₹23 Cr is the second-highest 3rd Saturday of all time, trailing only Dhurandhar Part 1. ₹1,000 Cr all-India will likely be achieved in Week 4 (D22-D25). Hindi alone crossing ₹1,000 Cr is now described as 'difficult' — may fall short of that specific milestone.

sources.name: Sacnilk
sources.quote: Sacnilk all-version tracking: ₹1,013 Cr through D18. 3rd weekend ₹75.95 Cr. Boxoffy call: 9.5% inflated vs BOI/Pinkvilla — not used for canonical data.
sources.analysis: Sacnilk all-version total through D18: ₹1,013 Cr. 3rd weekend: D16 ₹21.55 + D17 ₹25.65 + D18 ₹28.75 = ₹75.95 Cr. Sacnilk claims ₹1,000 Cr nett already crossed. Boxoffy position: Sacnilk is running 9.5% above BOI and Pinkvilla on cumulative totals. The three-source triangulation (BOI Hindi ₹887.33 + Pinkvilla all-India ₹925 Cr) converges at ~₹925 Cr. Sacnilk occupancy and show-count data remains reliable — only their cumulative totals are rejected. Sacnilk's WW gross (~₹1,525 Cr through D18) is not disputed as distributor-sourced data is harder to inflate.

interval_take: BOI confirmed it today: Hindi nett ₹887.33 Cr through D18. Add ~₹38 Cr from South-dubbed versions (Pinkvilla-verified), and the all-India nett lands at ~₹925 Cr. Sacnilk's ₹1,013 Cr is a 9.5% overcount — this is the inflation PB flagged, now confirmed by cross-referencing. The ₹1,000 Cr all-India milestone has NOT been crossed yet. It's ~₹75 Cr away. At the current Week 4 pace, D2 will cross ₹1,000 Cr India nett around D22–D25 (Apr 9-12). BOI's own call: 'on target but dependent on next few weeks.' Hindi-alone ₹1,000 Cr looks unlikely — Pinkvilla says as much. But all-version? That's a certainty, and it will make D2 only the third Indian film ever to hit that mark after Pushpa 2 and Baahubali 2.

interval_take: D12 Monday came in at ₹25.30 Cr — a natural dip as IPL 2026 began and the second weekday cycle settled. D0–D12 India nett stands at ₹867 Cr on BOI basis (Sacnilk calculates ₹872 Cr using D5 ₹65 Cr — Boxoffy takes BOI's ₹60 Cr). KGF Chapter 2's India lifetime (₹859.7 Cr nett) has been passed. ₹1,000 Cr nett is the next milestone — at D8-D12 averaging ₹49.5 Cr/day, the film needs 3–4 more strong days. WW stands at ~₹1,392 Cr. NA has already broken Baahubali 2's all-time Indian film record at $23M+. D2 is now the #2 Hindi film of all time in India nett behind Pathaan (₹543 Cr? No) — actually #1 Hindi film of all time.
nextWeek: D13 Tue + D14 Wed key — ₹1,000 Cr India nett target by Thu Apr 2. IPL headwind manageable on weekdays. D2 eyes Pathaan overseas record. No new major Hindi competition until mid-April.

interval_take: Boxoffy correction issued. After cross-referencing BOI and Pinkvilla against Sacnilk, Sacnilk Hindi figures appear inflated — particularly D1 where Sacnilk reports ₹99.1 Cr vs BOI ₹75 Cr and Pinkvilla ₹73 Cr, a 33% gap. Pinkvilla and BOI align closely throughout. Revised canonical: BOI Hindi D0-D7 ₹532 Cr + other languages ~₹30 Cr = ~₹562 Cr India nett. WW ₹1,006.50 Cr is not disputed — Sacnilk WW uses confirmed distributor data. BLOCKBUSTER verdict and all records unchanged — D2 is still historic at any number.
